sources.citation: Reimbay Reimbayev, The Lower Bound for Number of Hexagons in Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2, arXiv:2409.10620v1 (2024).
sources.hypotheses: The paper studies strongly regular graphs with lambda=1 and mu=2.
sources.supports: n12 is the induced hexagon count and n12=(1/12)nk(k-2)(2k^2-21k+53)+n3; theorem uses n3>=0.
sources.does_not_support: No n3>=705 or exact projector inequality.

sources.citation: Reimbay Reimbayev, European Journal of Applied Mathematics and Modelling, DOI 10.62780/ejaam/2024-001.
sources.supports: Journal version of the induced-hexagon identity.
sources.does_not_support: No positive target-specific n3 lower bound located.

sources.citation: Reimbay Reimbayev, The Subgraphs of Order Six of the Family of Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2, arXiv:2508.03377v2.
sources.hypotheses: The paper studies sufficiently large strongly regular graphs in the lambda=1, mu=2 family and explicitly treats the target family member.
sources.supports: N3 topology in the source figure; n3 is a free/unknown variable; repeats n12 identity.
sources.does_not_support: No positive lower bound for n3.

sources.citation: Connor Phillips, A Comprehensive Study of Clique Graphs and Clique Regular Graphs, arXiv:2605.22867v1 (2026).
sources.hypotheses: General clique-regular graph framework; the local tau,rho system is necessary for srg(n,k,1,mu).

sources.does_not_support: No occurrences of n3 or Schur; no target resolution or audited bound.

sources.citation: Y. Ishihara, Theory of the pain of humans etc., JSAI Technical Report, SIG-AGI-021-01 (2022), Theorem 28.
sources.audit_finding: Every L2 nonneighbor of w has at least one common neighbor with w in L2, so the induced L2 is connected from w. Equation (88) then assumes all 71 H2 vertices have two H1 neighbors. Exact root-label counting gives degrees 1^20 and 2^51, so the correct total is 122, not 142. The contradiction does not follow.
sources.status_effect: Not an accepted or valid resolution.
